  STATING A ROUNDING MODE CANNOT REPAIR A TIE. Across the four exact half-cent quantities in this charter, round() disagreed with exact half-up on TWO and agreed on TWO, purely by representation. Implementing half-up inside compute fails identically: int(296.405*100 + 0.5) = int(29640.999999999996) = 29640, i.e. it rounds DOWN. Therefore NO nameable decimal convention is reliably implementable on a tie, and the only sound design is that no scored quantity be one.
